newsitem.title: DENMARK: Realkredit sells 1.2 billion DKK in mortgage bonds.
newsitem.headline: Realkredit sells 1.2 billion DKK in mortgage bonds.

text.p: Danish mortgage lender Realkredit Danmark said it sold one billion crowns worth of its six percent 1998 mortgage-backed bond and 269 million of its six percent 1999 on Thursday in its first-ever sale by auction.
The day's price for the 1OD 1998 bond, for which bids totalling 5.487 billion crowns were received, was set at 101.052 and for the 1OD 1999 at 102.85, after 859 million crowns in bids, it said.

The auction was held to give Realkredit a picture of how best to sell bonds for the refinancing in January 1998 of its Flex-loan variable rate loans. --Eva Elgaard Pedersen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
